customer_reply: Thank you for reaching out. The bulk‑approve button is disabled because our system has a built‑in limit of 200 purchase orders per bulk action. This is a by‑design restriction (see KB‑4859). If you need to approve more than 200 POs at once, you can split them into smaller batches or use the bulk‑approve workflow in smaller groups. For any further assistance, let us know!
internal_note: Identified by design limit on bulk approval; not a bug. Customer needs workaround.
